Monday was a good day. I woke up feeling happy and went for a walk.
By lunch I had a terrible headache, and I felt a bit nauseous.
In the evening I was tired but I enjoyed cooking dinner with a friend.
Tuesday: I worried about the exam, and I felt anxious and stressed.
Later I relaxed with a great book and felt much better.
Wednesday was awful. I was sick, in pain, and a little lonely.
Thursday brought a wonderful surprise, and I was proud and glad.
